name: cozytavern
description: A lightweight SillyTavern-like AI chat frontend

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.start: node smart-build.js && cd server && npm start
scripts.setup: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd .. && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
